name: MonkeSprinters
summary: Welcome to "Monke Sprinters" – an electrifying VR experience where you and friends become agile primates racing through lush jungle. Use your hands to sprint, climb, and leap, feeling the rush of wind as you bound from branch to branch. Discover hidden treasures unlocking new cosmetics. Express your unique style with accessories from feathered headdresses to woven bracelets. With endless customization options, the jungle becomes your canvas for self-expression. Join friends for intense races, playful games,
